boundary: This parses a 260-point time-reversal-reduced sample from the nominal 8x8x8 grid. It does not establish a converged fundamental, quasiparticle, optical, or experimental gap.

recorded_ledger.claim_boundary: Hash-bound teaching samples from separately recorded real QE stages. The line path and 260-point time-reversal-reduced 8x8x8 sample are different samplings; neither sampled separation is a converged fundamental, quasiparticle, optical, or experimental gap, and no continuous historical launcher is claimed.

full_zone_sample.symmetry_policy: Nominal 8x8x8 automatic grid with nosym=.true.; noinv=.true. was not set, so time-reversal equivalence remained and QE printed 260 points rather than a 512-point enumeration.

sampling_policy: Nominal 8x8x8 automatic grid with nosym=.true.; noinv=.true. absent, so time-reversal equivalence remained and QE printed 260 points.
